question:
An 84-year-old male patient is hospitalized for pneumonia management and has been recovering well
with an uneventful hospital course. As his discharge nears, the patient’s cousin, who has not been
present during most of the hospitalization, visits for the first time. The cousin, as the patient’s primary
caretaker, inquires about the patient’s prognosis and potential discharge date to plan for his return
home. The patient is expected to be discharged in the next few days. What is the most appropriate
response in this situation? Answer Choices: (A) Bring the cousin to the room and ask the patient if it is
acceptable to disclose his course (B) Tell the cousin that you do not know the patient's course well (C)
Explain that you cannot discuss the patient's care at this time (D) Provide general information about
pneumonia recovery timelines without disclosing specifics (E) Reassure the cousin that the patient is
stable but avoid giving further details (F) Inform the cousin of the discharge plan since he is the primary
caretaker (G) Ask the cousin to contact the patient directly for updates on his care (H) Discuss the
patient’s condition with the cousin since he is a family member (I) Suggest the cousin speak to the

nurse for more details (J) Ask the cousin to provide proof of legal guardianship before discussing the
patient’s care
 A. Discuss the patient’s condition with the cousin since he is a family member
B. Inform the cousin of the discharge plan since he is the primary caretaker
C. Reassure the cousin that the patient is stable but avoid giving further details
D. Provide general information about pneumonia recovery timelines without disclosing specifics
E. Ask the cousin to contact the patient directly for updates on his care
F. Explain that you cannot discuss the patient's care at this time
G. Ask the cousin to provide proof of legal guardianship before discussing the patient’s care
H. Tell the cousin that you do not know the patient's course well
I. Bring the cousin to the room and ask the patient if it is acceptable to disclose his course
J. Suggest the cousin speak to the nurse for more details
